summary: The founder's 'Thanks for subscribing to Rallly Pro' email is no longer sent immediately from the Stripe webhook; it is queued (inside the subscription-sync transaction, deduped per subscription) to send 30 minutes later and is skipped if the subscription is no longer active or the user is deleted/banned. Migration turns queued_emails.kind from an enum into text and drops the enum type.

statements.why: No auth/secret/money exposure; webhook is still Stripe-signed; email recipients unchanged (subscriber only).

statements.text: Most of this change is in apps/web/src/features/billing/webhook/mutations.ts (65 lines added, 18 removed).

statements.why: kind becomes String, enum removed; vague.

statements.text: The agent also changed queue.ts, billing/constants.ts, billing/data.ts, webhook/mutations.ts, email-queue/constants.ts and email-queue/mutations.ts, in ways plain can't describe yet.
Apply migration 20261015120000_queued_email_kind_to_text before the new code goes live, or the parts that use it will fail.
statements.why: Without it, inserting kind 'subscription_feedback' into the enum column fails inside the subscription transaction (webhook/mutations.ts:312), and the claim query compares the enum to a text array.

misses.what: New Pro subscribers now get the founder's thank-you/feedback email 30 minutes after subscribing instead of right away, only once even if Stripe resends the event, and not at all if they cancel (or are banned/deleted) before it goes out.

The email is now queued inside the same database transaction that records the subscription, so a problem queueing it would make the subscription webhook fail (Stripe retries) rather than just skipping the email.
